rationale: This is exceptional editorial data design: the report's central argument shapes its typography, page architecture, charts, marginal apparatus and interactions rather than merely supplying content to a theme. The responsive work is especially convincing, with tables becoming records, monthly data becoming a purposeful annual comparison, and marginal notes folding into readable endnotes; the main limitation is that the very wide layouts sometimes leave excessive inactive space and lose some narrative pressure.

criterionScores.note: The measure-and-margin thesis is visible throughout: disciplined reading columns, ruled annotations, restrained ink and rust, exposed methodological apparatus and charts that belong to the publication.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: At wide widths, the severe two-column discipline occasionally becomes under-composed emptiness rather than productive editorial space.
positiveEvidence: The consistent reading-column and marginal-apparatus relationship gives the entire report a specific visual argument.
Rules, figure labels, citations, metadata and simulated-data warnings form one coherent editorial language.
The homepage, findings, method, catchments and data pages retain the thesis while changing structure to suit their content.

criterionScores.note: The experience is inseparable from a research report about missing observations: coverage grids, reported-versus-underlying comparisons, methodological controls, citation mechanics and explicit limits all determine the design.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The broader editorial skeleton could still support another evidence-heavy investigative report, even though it could not plausibly become an unrelated commercial site.
positiveEvidence: The central interactive grid connects monitor coverage, published spills and simulated discharges in one readout.
Every finding is paired with what it does not support and the figure it rests on.
Catchment profiles, coverage sparklines, simulation warnings and reproducibility parameters are structural rather than decorative.

criterionScores.note: The report is edited into a persuasive route structure: a thesis-led front page, citable findings, comparative catchments, reproducible method and complete data, with previews and cross-references that earn navigation.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The data route remains extremely long on mobile, and the screenshots do not demonstrate pagination, search, download behaviour or other ways to manage all 720 rows beyond catchment filtering.
positiveEvidence: The homepage explains the thesis, demonstrates it with two figures, introduces the key inversion and then routes into four distinct chapters.
Findings are stable, numbered and explicitly tied to supporting figures and limitations.
The method and data chapters separate reproducibility, attribution, reuse and raw records instead of overloading the narrative pages.

criterionScores.note: Headlines, standfirsts, figure titles, findings, evidence, qualifications and marginal notes have clearly different weights, and hierarchy changes appropriately between narrative, reference and tabular pages.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Several wide and desktop pages distribute relatively small content across very large fields, reducing urgency and making some secondary blocks feel detached from the arguments they qualify.

criterionScores.note: Typography performs genuine compositional work across display serif, readable narrative text, condensed apparatus labels, table typography, captions, citations and restrained spot-colour emphasis.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Some annotation and table text becomes extremely small in the wide screenshots, and the condensed sans metadata can look faint at those scales.
positiveEvidence: The opening headline is editorially expressive without becoming an unrelated display effect.
Dense figure labels, captions, sources, metadata and qualifications remain distinguishable through weight, case, tracking and family.
Mobile type measures and line heights are deliberately reset rather than inherited mechanically from desktop.

criterionScores.note: Dense evidence alternates with spacious interpretation, section rules create pauses, and the scroll moves between argument, figure, apparatus and qualification rather than repeating one generic module.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The wide compositions sometimes over-release into large blank zones, while repeated two-column sections on findings and method settle into a predictable cadence.

criterionScores.note: The material is exactly what this subject needs: coverage matrices, comparative scatter plots, difference bands, sparklines and transparent data tables, all styled as evidence within the report.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The catchment sparklines are useful but visually repetitive, and the screenshots do not show richer explanatory interaction or annotation within the larger charts.
positiveEvidence: The coverage grid makes missing observation itself visible rather than illustrating the topic indirectly.
The reported-versus-underlying scatter plot turns the control into part of the visible argument.
Catchment difference bands show how the same events look through differently functioning monitoring estates.

criterionScores.note: The supplied states demonstrate unusually conscientious micro-craft: distinct current and hover navigation, visible keyboard focus, a skip link, focus-driven grid readouts, row feedback and reduced-motion handling.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The evidence covers a focused set of interactions rather than a broader interactive system, and the 720 individually focusable grid cells may still be laborious despite being keyboard-operable.

criterionScores.note: Mobile is treated as its own editorial format: complex tables become records, the sixty-month grid becomes five comparable annual columns, margins become endnotes, and page statistics and figures are regrouped around reading order.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The mobile data chapter still requires an exceptionally long traversal of sixty records, with no captured evidence of additional navigation aids.
positiveEvidence: The seven-column catchment table becomes twelve legible records while preserving full-width sparklines.
The phone coverage figure uses annual aggregation specifically to preserve cross-catchment comparison instead of shrinking or horizontally panning sixty columns.
Marginal commentary folds beneath the relevant reading column rather than collapsing into unusable narrow text.
Chart legends, summaries, navigation and footer content are deliberately regrouped at mobile width.

criterionScores.note: The restrained investigative-publication voice feels credible for a small independent data unit addressing reporters, regulators and river communities: serious, transparent and quietly adversarial.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Its austerity sometimes makes Stell feel more like an anonymous report imprint than a fully developed organisation with a broader recognisable identity.
positiveEvidence: The design foregrounds evidence, limits, funding, reuse and simulation status rather than institutional promotion.
The rust accent reads as editorial correction and warning rather than lifestyle branding.
The apparatus-heavy language supports the organisation's claimed independence and statistical seriousness.

criterionScores.note: The proposition is immediate, navigation is plain, trust information is pervasive, and Download & cite provides an appropriate next action for this non-commercial publication.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The screenshots do not reveal what Download & cite contains or whether readers can obtain machine-readable data directly, and the site's intentionally report-like voice offers little organisational context beyond the publication.

criterionScores.note: The work avoids virtually every generic generated-site reflex and replaces them with decisions traceable to investigative publishing, statistical qualification and the mechanics of missing monitoring data.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The restrained serif-and-whitespace idiom is not unique by itself; its distinction depends on the excellent apparatus and data structures carrying it.
positiveEvidence: There are no generic feature cards, blobs, gradients, logo walls, invented testimonials or promotional KPI slabs.
Statistics appear only where they advance or qualify the report's argument.
Whitespace, rules, captions and marginalia operate as publication machinery rather than premium styling tokens.
The responsive transformations are content-specific and could not have come from a generic landing-page system.

criterionScores.note: The signature experience is the coverage grid that makes missing monitoring visible and connects each selected month to what was observed versus what the simulation says occurred; the measure-and-margin reading apparatus reinforces it across the report.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Outside the central grid and inversion comparison, several long-form pages rely on a quieter editorial grammar that is excellent but less individually unforgettable.
positiveEvidence: The interactive field of monitor coverage directly embodies the report's sentence: an offline monitor records nothing, not zero.
The Elverley-versus-Cleeve-Brook inversion is staged repeatedly across narrative, chart, table and catchment profiles.
The persistent pairing of claims with their limits and supporting figures creates a distinctive reading experience.

signatureMoment: The monitor-coverage grid: selecting a pale month exposes, in one compact readout, the percentage of monitors reporting, the spills that would be published and the larger number the simulation says actually occurred.

comparisons.note: Both use an authored editorial system in which typography, annotation and charts carry the argument; the candidate is more austere and apparatus-led.
The candidate has excellent multilevel typography, but the reference is described as sustaining a still broader hierarchy across a denser and more varied document.
The candidate paces density and release well, but its widest layouts occasionally become excessively empty and some chapter rhythms repeat.
The candidate's thesis-to-findings-to-catchments-to-method-to-data structure is exceptionally clear and its cross-references make the evidence chain inspectable.
The supplied evidence demonstrates unusually explicit mobile reinterpretation, including annual aggregation, record-based tables and folded marginalia.
The candidate demonstrates integrated chart styling, careful small typography, keyboard states, reduced-motion behaviour and content-specific responsive decisions.
The reference is memorable through sustained editorial rhythm; the candidate through the coverage grid, inversion and persistent claim-limit-evidence apparatus.
Nearly every structural and interactive decision in the candidate is tied directly to monitoring coverage, simulated truth, published counts and evidentiary limits.

benchmarkGapDetail: The reference retains a modest advantage in refinement or craft. Close, not equal.

evidenceCeiling.detail: Evidence covers all 7 route(s) of this artifact at 4 viewport(s). Nothing is unphotographed, so evidence caps the claim at 10.
